metadata.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
metadata.Description: This comprehensive Basic Unity Training Program is designed to equip participants with essential skills in Unity game development. Starting from the fundamentals of Unity interface and scripting in C#, the course progresses to cover advanced topics such as physics, animations, and user interface design. Through a combination of lectures, hands-on labs, and real-world projects, participants will gain practical experience and confidence in using Unity for game development.
metadata.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose- Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
metadata.Tools: - Internet- Visual Studio 2019 or later (C# programming language)- Unity software (latest version)- Students use Unity with their personal email for educational purposes only

sections.heading: Syllabus Details
rows: Game Programming with C#_Lập trình Game với C#
Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study

This comprehensive Basic Unity Training Program is designed to equip participants with essential skills in Unity game development. Starting from the fundamentals of Unity interface and scripting in C#, the course progresses to cover advanced topics such as physics, animations, and user interface design. Through a combination of lectures, hands-on labs, and real-world projects, participants will gain practical experience and confidence in using Unity for game development.

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose- Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information
- Internet- Visual Studio 2019 or later (C# programming language)- Unity software (latest version)- Students use Unity with their personal email for educational purposes only

sections.heading: 7 LO(s)
rows: Understand the Unity interface and basic tools for game development
Write and implement C# scripts for game logic and interactions.
Create and manipulate game objects, animations, and physics components.
Design user interfaces and handle user input effectively.
Develop small games and interactive applications using Unity.
Troubleshoot and debug common Unity issues.
Collaborate effectively in a team environment for game development projects.
